author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: Falling yields and a weaker dollar did the heavy lifting in November: the 10Y fell 39 bps over 20 observations to 4.47% in a bull flattening of an inverted curve, DXY dropped 3.00% and the VIX sank to 12.46, so markets now price a finished Fed while the Fed's own minutes insist rates must stay high. With hedge-fund crowding at a record and consumer, housing, German and Chinese activity softening, the edition favours owning the rates move (duration, quality growth, REITs, small caps, dollar-weakness beneficiaries such as EPOL) over late-cycle cyclicals, and treats oil and China property as the places where the policy put is weakest.
sources_policy: Facts only from the 2023-11-27 frozen own-date feed (digest.py) and the 2023-11-27 market card (showcard.py); exclusions n0635, n0797, n1631 not cited; company news/previews <=7 days, company results <=14 days, macro/policy <=35 days; no spot-FX levels or returns; previews used only as pending events; numbers only from the card or from headlines cited in the same part.
known_ambiguities_omitted: n0016 (Guardian, RBA hike to 4.35%) carries a 2023-11-06 08:00 timestamp that precedes the 2023-11-07 decision; safe in substance for this edition but not cited, and the 4.35% level omitted; n0025 used instead.
n1019 (Reuters, BoE should look more at money supply) may reflect a UK parliamentary report under a Monday 00:01 GMT embargo; not cited.
n0737 / n0712 (Berkshire sold P&G and UPS stakes): underlying 13F disclosure is older than the seven-day company-news window; not cited.
n0821 (Morningstar on Disney after earnings): underlying results older than fourteen days; not cited.
n0254 (analysts cut Alibaba targets by up to 25%): sits on the seven-day company-news boundary with the restructuring event older; not cited.

n0854 (TradingView Bank of Nova Scotia earnings page, 'result' 2023-11-21), n0943 (TradingView Broadcom earnings page), n0937 (TradingView Royalty Pharma EPS page): rolling data pages labelled as results; BNS and Broadcom quarterly reports had not occurred before cutoff; not cited.
n0099 and n0666 (Yahoo Finance Australia quote/holder pages) and n0695 (Bespoke 'My Research'): rolling pages without a dated event; not cited.
n1338, n1364, n1227, n1224, n1391, n1333, n1337 carry numeric spot-FX quotes; złoty direction taken only from n1309/n1301 without levels.

n1128 (Japan CPI preview) superseded by the completed-print headline n1141; n1579 ('(2024)' evergreen EV page) not cited; n0204 (WION protest claims) and n1440 (speculative Russian border movements) judged too weak to cite.

n1021, n0096, n0147 and n1438 are dated 2023-11-26; each was checked as plausibly before 00:00 UTC on 2023-11-27 (dollar weakness is corroborated by the DXY move to the 2023-11-24 close; a Sunday or Monday-morning AEDT announcement precedes UTC midnight; n0147 is a feature on debt maturities; n1438 is used only as a pending swearing-in, never as a completed event).

n0834 (Mining.com, Franco-Nevada cuts guidance on Cobre Panama woes, timestamped 2023-11-20, result category): the guidance cut plausibly accompanied the company's early-November quarterly release, so the record may be older than its timestamp and outside the fourteen-day results window; not cited and suggested for exclusion review.
n0094 (Hauser appointed RBA deputy, 2023-11-26) dropped to avoid any doubt over a Monday-morning AEDT announcement time.
n0016 timestamp anomaly aside, the 2023-11-27 Polish swearing-in (n1358, n1438) and Cyber Monday items are treated strictly as pending on the report date.
